title: Cristaux et cohomologie de De Rham : généralités, correspondances Deligne et Berthelot (1965-1969) : notes manuscrites (s.d.), lettre (1965).

errors: No mathematical errors can be judged on this page itself; it is an offset ghost of page 2.
The comparison claims on page 2 (equivalences in the smooth case / characteristic 0) are standard and correct as stated.

ideas.what: Crystalline Chern class of a line bundle as the obstruction to extending it to an invertible crystal
ideas.modern_name: Crystalline first Chern class (via dlog / divided-power log)
ideas.where_published: Crystals and the de Rham cohomology of schemes, Dix exposés §7 (approximately)

deep.surprise_reason: The page is a faint offset copy of page 2. Its content (the diagram of crystalline-type topoi and crystalline Chern classes) is the standard material of Grothendieck's 1966 IHES lectures.
transcription_corrections: The diagram nodes are, from the top: X_zar; X_conn ⇢ X_P-conn; X_strat in the middle; X_cris ⇢ X_P-cris; X_inf; X_zar at the bottom, matching page 2.
The bracketed note reads '[⇢ défini si X de torsion sur Z]'.
The NB box reads 'NB | S sous-entendu dans notations'.

The faint text below the diagram corresponds line by line to page 2: arrows to X_zar and localization isomorphisms; arrows from X_zar and the exact sequence 0→J→O→O_0→0; the Chern class c'(L) in H^2(X_cris) and H^2(X_P-cris).
The page appears to be an offset impression of the next sheet, not original writing.
